summary: Whetstone Mountain lookout, Marion County, OR: 20-ft tower with L-5 cab built 1933-34, gone by 1967 or burned 1968; hike reported closed in 2026.

facts.design: 20-foot wooden tower with an L-5 cab (register)
facts.status_note: Gone by 1967 per the register and firelookout.com; Forest Lookouts says the structure was burned in October 1968

access.note: Oregon Hikers marks the hike closed (notice dated August 2026, Austin Fire); the Forest Service trail page lists current wildfire closures on the Willamette National Forest. Not checked against a current closure order.

visit.trail_note: Trail #3369 climbs toward the summit from both ends. Hike Oregon describes the summit as a flat area where a lookout once stood. No source describes what remains there.

events.note: Forest Lookouts: 10 by 10 L-5 lookout house constructed by the CCC; Oregon Statesman item from September 1933 describes building under way

Panorama photos taken by Robert Cooper and Albert Arnst (May 24, 1934)
Gone by 1967 per the register and firelookout.com
Forest Lookouts: structure disposed of by burning on October 11, 1968
Oregon Hikers notice (August 2026): area closed because of the Austin Fire

resolved_conflicts.explanation: The register and firelookout.com give 1934; Forest Lookouts gives 1933, and a September 1933 newspaper item describes construction under way. Not reconciled; the story gives both years.
The register and firelookout.com say gone by 1967; Forest Lookouts says the structure was disposed of by burning on October 11, 1968. Not reconciled; the story gives both dates.

notes_for_editor: Oregon Hikers files the hike under the Mt Hood National Forest; the Forest Service trail page is on the Willamette. The closure notice is dated August 2026 and may be out of date by 2026-10-09; not verified against the closure order. The register links a photo 'Whetstone Mountain Lookout 1958' (Howard Verschoor collection); no image URL was read, so no photo was added. No staffing or lookout-fire information found in the sources read.
